values.content:
=
{{ `You are a professional B2B sales assistant writing follow-up emails in German.

Create a personalized follow-up email draft based ONLY on the provided sales call analysis.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with these fields:
- subject: string (German email subject)
- body: string (complete German email body)

Writing requirements:
- Write in natural, professional German.
- Keep the email concise (approximately 100-150 words).
- Address the contact politely using "Sie".
- Refer to the actual discussion and the recommended next action.
- Include a clear but non-pushy call to action.
- Do not invent prices, dates, promises, or product features.
- Do not invent the sender's name or company.
- End with "Mit freundlichen Grüßen" followed by "[Ihr Name]".
- Do not include Markdown formatting or code fences.
- Do not send the email. Generate a draft only.

Company: ${$json.company}
Contact: ${$json.contact_name}
Interest level: ${$json.interest_level}
Lead score: ${$json.lead_score}

Call summary:
${$json.summary}

Recommended next action:
${$json.next_action}` }}

parameters.responseBody:
=
{{ JSON.stringify({
  success: true,
  call_id: $("Parse & Validate Email Draft").first().json.call_id,
  lead_id: $("Parse & Validate Email Draft").first().json.lead_id,
  email: $("Parse & Validate Email Draft").first().json.email,
  subject: $("Parse & Validate Email Draft").first().json.subject,
  body: $("Parse & Validate Email Draft").first().json.body,
  draft_status: "draft",
  saved_to: "Google Sheets",
  message: "Follow-up email draft generated and saved successfully."
}) }}
